medium confidence · The function initializes the caller-provided 32-bit output to -1, checks a global/context value, calls player_attribute_get_float for selector 0x52, converts the returned float to a signed integer, and stores that integer to the output pointer at x19 (decompiled/main/main_0124.c:13676-13705). medium confidence · Selects one of two record bases from the input selector, reads the record fields at +0x584 and +0x588, computes a table entry from the selected base and value, prepares update arguments, and musttail forwards to update_generated_attribute_rating_curve. medium confidence · Both control paths store byte value 1 through the pointer loaded from global address 0x7002280000+0x518.
